params.failureMessage: Assert Control Book Schema failed
params.expectedColumns: As of Date, Shares Issued, Issued & Outstanding, Comment

guards.name: Warn EQ Control Book Comment Spelling Variants

params.sql:
select case
  when (select count(*) from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')) = 0 then '0 行'
  else concat('影响 ', (select count(*) from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')), ' 行 / ', (select sum([Shares Issued]) from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')), ' 股，Comment 拼写为：', '
', (select group_concat(distinct [Comment] separator '
') from {control_book} where ([Comment] like '%mnibus%' or [Comment] like '%minibus%') and not (lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl' or lower([Comment]) like 'omnibus%inc%pl.')))
end as comment_variant_hint
params.failureMessage:
EQ Control Book 的 Comment 列发现与规范写法不一致的 Omnibus 拼写（例如 Ominibus）。
这些行已按模糊匹配计入 2025 BC Subplan shares transferred to Futu，本次汇总数值不受影响、无需重算。
建议在源数据（Shareworks 控制账簿导出）中把 Comment 改成规范写法 "Omnibus Inc. Pl"，否则以后每个月都会在此停下确认。
（空格、标点与大小写差异视为格式差异，不算拼写变体：Omnibus Inc.Pl. 等写法会被直接接受。）

guards.name: Warn Duplicate BC Subplan Transfer Rows

params.sql:
select case
  when (select count(*) from (select 1 from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) group by [As of Date], [Process Date], [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding] having count(*) > 1) g) = 0 then '0 组'
  else concat('发现 ',
    (select count(*) from (select 1 from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) group by [As of Date], [Process Date], [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding] having count(*) > 1) g), ' 组重复的 BC Subplan transfer，已按一笔计入：',
    (select group_concat(distinct h separator '；') from (select concat(cast(wf_month_key([As of Date]) as string), ' / ', cast([Shares Issued] as string), ' 股') as h from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) group by [As of Date], [Process Date], [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding] having count(*) > 1) t))
end as bc_duplicate_hint
from {control_book}
limit 1
params.failureMessage:
EQ Control Book 里同一笔 BC Subplan transfer 出现了多行（同 As of Date、同股数、同期末余额），本次已按一笔计入，「2025 BC Subplan shares transferred to Futu」的数值不受影响。
常见原因是 base 与当月增量用了两种导出格式（例如一行是 BOOK ENTRY ISSUANCE、另一行是 O.I.），合并时无法识别为同一笔。
建议在源数据中删除重复行；确认后继续即可。

params.sql:
select
  (select [Issued & Outstanding] from {control_book} where [Issued & Outstanding] is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth} order by __workflow_row_number desc limit 1) as eom_eq_balance_os,
  (select [Issued & Outstanding] from {control_book} where [Issued & Outstanding] is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) < {constants.workflowMonth} order by __workflow_row_number desc limit 1) as last_month_eq_balance_os,
  (select wf_month_key([As of Date]) from {control_book} where [Issued & Outstanding] is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) is not null and wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth} order by __workflow_row_number desc limit 1) as last_control_book_month,
  coalesce((select sum(t.[Shares Issued]) from (
    select [As of Date], [Process Date], [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding]
    from {control_book} where ([Comment] like 'Omnibus Inc%Pl%' or [Comment] like 'Ominibus Inc%Pl%') and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth})
    group by [As of Date], [Process Date], [Shares Issued], [Issued & Outstanding]
  ) t), 0) as bc_subplan_transfer_control_book,
  coalesce(max(case when [Trans. Type] = 'Agr. & Pl. of Merger'
    and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) then [Shares Issued] else null end), 0) as cullgen_common_stock,
  coalesce(max(case when [Comment] = 'Equity Inc.Sub-Pl. Futu Network Technology'
    and (wf_month_key([As of Date]) is null or wf_month_key([As of Date]) <= {constants.workflowMonth}) then [Shares Issued] else null end), 0) as gyre_2023_china_subplan_total
from {control_book}

tasks.description: 从合并后的 EQ Control Book 汇总当月指标：EOM / Last Month 余额、2025 BC Subplan transfer、Cullgen common stock 与 Gyre 2023 China SubPlan 总数全部按 As of Date 截断到 workflow 月份（同一份完整 Control Book 可回算任意历史月份）。BC Subplan transfer 按 Comment 模糊匹配 Omnibus / Ominibus 的 Shares Issued 求和，并按「经济指纹」（As of Date + Process Date + Shares Issued + Issued & Outstanding）去重：同一笔转账在 base 与增量两种导出格式里各出现一次时要算一笔；真正的两笔同股数转账期末余额不同，仍各自计入。重复行会在运行页给出 warning。Cullgen common stock 取 Trans. Type = Agr. & Pl. of Merger 的 Shares Issued，合并发生前该月为 0（合并行 2026-05 才出现）；Gyre 2023 China SubPlan 总数同理取 Equity Inc.Sub-Pl. Futu Network Technology 行，该行出现前为 0。

tasks.name: Calc 2025 BC Subplan Cancelled

params.failureMessage: 2025 BC Subplan Transfer input must contain 行标签 and 总计 columns

params.sql:
select
  coalesce(
    abs(min(case when [总计] < 0 then [总计] else null end)),
    max(case when trim(coalesce(cast([行标签] as text), '')) like '总计%' then [总计] else null end)
      - min(case when trim(coalesce(cast([行标签] as text), '')) like '总计%' then [总计] else null end)
  ) as bc_subplan_cancelled,
  coalesce(
    min(case when trim(coalesce(cast([行标签] as text), '')) like '总计%' then [总计] else null end),
    max(case when trim(coalesce(cast([行标签] as text), '')) like '总计%' then [总计] else null end)
      + min(case when [总计] < 0 then [总计] else null end)
  ) as bc_subplan_outstanding
from {transfer}

tasks.description: 从用户指定的 2025 BC Subplan Transfer/Vesting Schedule Sheet 计算 cancelled/forfeited shares；优先读取负数取消总计，兼容两个总计行的差额格式。该源为可选的交叉校验输入：未提供时不告警、不拦截运行。

tasks.name: Calc Option Plan Metrics

params.failureMessage: Assert Option Plan Schema failed

params.sql:
with totals as (
  select
    p.key,
    sum(p.[value]) as total_value
  from {plans} p
  where p.key in (
    'Awards Outstanding',
    'Shares Remaining For Issuance',
    'Awards Outstanding + Shares Remaining for Issuance'
  )
  group by p.key
),
bc_plan as (
  select
    sum(case when p.key = 'Cancelled' then coalesce(p.[value], 0) else 0 end) as cancelled_value,
    sum(case when p.key = 'Awards Outstanding' then 1 else 0 end) as awards_row_count
  from {plans} p
  where p.plan_name = 'GYRE 2025 BC Subplan'
    or p.category_for_grouping like '%GYRE 2025 BC Subplan%'
),
bc_adjustment as (
  select
    case
      when coalesce(max(bc_plan.awards_row_count), 0) > 0
        and coalesce(abs(max(bc_plan.cancelled_value)), 0) = 0
      then coalesce(max(bc_subplan.bc_subplan_cancelled), 0)
      else 0
    end as bc_cancelled_adjustment
  from bc_plan, {bc_subplan} bc_subplan
)
select
  coalesce(max(case when totals.key = 'Awards Outstanding' then totals.total_value else null end), 0)
    - max(bc_adjustment.bc_cancelled_adjustment) as total_options_outstanding,
  coalesce(max(case when totals.key = 'Shares Remaining For Issuance' then totals.total_value else null end), 0)
    + max(bc_adjustment.bc_cancelled_adjustment) as total_options_available,
  coalesce(max(case when totals.key = 'Awards Outstanding + Shares Remaining for Issuance' then totals.total_value else null end), 0) as total_options_outstanding_plus_available,
  max(bc_adjustment.bc_cancelled_adjustment) as bc_subplan_cancelled_adjustment
from totals, bc_adjustment

params.sql: select case when cullgen_common_stock = {constants.cullgenCommonStock} then 1 else 0 end as actual from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: Cullgen common stock 与月度固定参数 cullgen_common_stock 不一致（对账失败，已阻断）。Control Book 按 As of Date 截断后该列见下文实际值；合并发生前（2026-05 之前）该值应为 0。请核对 Control Book 的 Agr. & Pl. of Merger 行，或到月度页面修正该固定参数。

params.sql: select case when gyre_2023_china_subplan_total = {constants.gyre2023ChinaSubplanTotal} then 1 else 0 end as actual from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: Gyre 2023 China SubPlan total 与月度固定参数 gyre_2023_china_subplan_total 不一致（对账失败，已阻断）。两类值的实际值见下文；Equity Inc.Sub-Pl. Futu Network Technology 行出现前（2024-07 之前）该值应为 0。请核对 Control Book 或到月度页面修正该固定参数。

params.sql:
select
  max(c.eom_eq_balance_os) as eom_eq_balance_os,
  max(c.cullgen_common_stock) as cullgen_common_stock,
  max(c.gyre_2023_china_subplan_total) as gyre_2023_china_subplan_total,
  max(c.bc_subplan_transfer_control_book) as bc_subplan_transfer_selected,
  'control_book' as bc_subplan_transfer_selection_source,
  {constants.warrantsConvertiblePreferred} as warrants_for_convertible_preferred_stock,
  max(s.series_b_preferred_stock) as series_b_preferred_stock,
  {constants.optionsOutstandingCullgen} as options_outstanding_cullgen,
  {constants.optionsAvailableCullgen} as options_available_cullgen,
  round(max(c.eom_eq_balance_os) + max(o.total_options_outstanding) + {constants.warrantsConvertiblePreferred} + max(s.series_b_preferred_stock) - max(c.bc_subplan_transfer_control_book) + max(o.total_options_available) + {constants.optionsOutstandingCullgen} + {constants.optionsAvailableCullgen}, 0) as total_fully_diluted
from {control_metrics} c, {option_metrics} o, {series_b_metrics} s

params.sql: select case when bc_subplan_transfer_control_book >= 0 then 1 else 0 end as actual from {control_metrics}
params.failureMessage: Control Book 的 2025 BC Subplan transfer 缺失（为空）：无法计算 Total Fully Diluted 中的扣减项。0 是允许的（转仓发生前的月份），只有空值才阻断。

params.sql:
select '' as Number, 'Issued Shares -Equity Asset Class' as Description,
  null as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  null as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs}
union all select '' as Number, 'Asset Class Summary: EOM' as Description,
  b.eom_eq_balance_os as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  null as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '1' as Number, 'Common Shares OS' as Description,
  b.eom_eq_balance_os - b.cullgen_common_stock - f.bci_shares_held_by_futu - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  (b.eom_eq_balance_os - b.cullgen_common_stock - f.bci_shares_held_by_futu - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected) / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {futu_metrics} f, {business_inputs} b
union all select '2' as Number, 'Cullgen common stock' as Description,
  b.cullgen_common_stock as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.cullgen_common_stock / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '3' as Number, 'BCI Shares Held by Futu' as Description,
  f.bci_shares_held_by_futu as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  f.bci_shares_held_by_futu / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {futu_metrics} f, {business_inputs} b
union all select '4' as Number, '2025 BC Subplan shares transferred to Futu' as Description,
  b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '' as Number, 'Derivative Equity Incentives' as Description,
  null as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  null as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs}
union all select '5' as Number, 'Warrants for Convertible Preferred Stock' as Description,
  b.warrants_for_convertible_preferred_stock as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.warrants_for_convertible_preferred_stock / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '6' as Number, 'Series B Preferred Stock' as Description,
  b.series_b_preferred_stock as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.series_b_preferred_stock / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '7' as Number, 'Options Outstanding- Gyre' as Description,
  o.total_options_outstanding - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  (o.total_options_outstanding - b.bc_subplan_transfer_selected) / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {option_metrics} o, {business_inputs} b
union all select '8' as Number, 'Options Available- Gyre' as Description,
  o.total_options_available as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  o.total_options_available / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {option_metrics} o, {business_inputs} b
union all select '9' as Number, 'Options Outstanding- Cullgen' as Description,
  b.options_outstanding_cullgen as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.options_outstanding_cullgen / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '10' as Number, 'Options Available- Cullgen' as Description,
  b.options_available_cullgen as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  b.options_available_cullgen / b.total_fully_diluted as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b
union all select '' as Number, 'Total Fully Diluted Shares Outstand' as Description,
  b.total_fully_diluted as [Common Shares Equivalent],
  1 as [% of fully diluted]
from {business_inputs} b

tasks.description: 将通过校验后的 Summary View 持久化为 Excel 并写入 Files；百分比列导出为 Excel 百分号格式但保留真实小数值。

tasks.name: Invoke Read SERIES B
tasks.description: 调用 Read SERIES B 子工作流，读取 43105 Sheet 的 Shares Issued 合计值。

tasks.name: Calculate Series B Preferred Stock

params.sql: select coalesce(max([Shares Issued Total]), 0) * 5 as series_b_preferred_stock from {series_b}

tasks.description: 将 Read SERIES B 返回的 Shares Issued 合计乘以 5，得到 Summary 使用的 Series B Preferred Stock 数值；未提供 SERIES B Control Book 时该值为 0。

tasks.name: Invoke Exercise Record Sync
tasks.description: 调用 ESOP 行权记录同步，写出本月「行权记录」快照（月份透传，文件名带月份后缀）。两个来源都可选：都未提供时跳过，任一提供则执行。

tasks.name: Invoke Sold Shares Sync
tasks.description: 调用 ESOP 卖出记录同步，写出本月「卖出记录」快照。来源可选：未提供时跳过。

tasks.name: Invoke Cancellation Record Sync
tasks.description: 调用取消记录同步，写出本月「取消记录」快照。复用月度已收集的「取消与恢复报表」，未提供时跳过。

tasks.name: Invoke Grant Record Sync
tasks.description: 调用 ESOP 授予记录同步，写出本月「授予记录」快照（月份透传，文件名带月份后缀）。两个来源都可选：都未提供时跳过，任一提供则执行。
